sources: https://paldb.cc/en/Breeding_Farm — full CombiRank table for all 299 pals ('Breed Combi' tab) and all 164 special/unique breeding combinations ('Breed Unique' tab); raw HTML kept at data/raw/paldb_breeding.html (fetched 2026-07-14)

https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Breeding — exact formula wording child = floor((A + B + 1) / 2), tie-break 'lowest index number is selected', gender requirement, excluded/same-species-only pals (fetched 2026-07-14)
https://palworld.ludbase.com/en/tools/breeding/ — 1.0 confirmation of the floor((rankA + rankB + 1) / 2) formula and of ~135 special override combinations (fetched 2026-07-14)
https://advancecalchub.app/blog/palworld-breeding-guide-best-pals — gender requirement and parent order-insensitivity (pre-1.0 era page; used only for mechanics, not ranks) (fetched 2026-07-14)
gaps: Tie-break rule has conflicting documentation: palworld.wiki.gg says the lower internal index wins on exact CombiRank ties, while one 1.0-era aggregator claims ties resolve to the higher CombiRank; not independently verified in-game for 1.0.
Eleven crossover pals share CombiRank 3100, so formula results among them depend entirely on the tie-break rule / their exclusion from the generic pool.
paldb.cc does not print an explicit game-version stamp on the Breeding_Farm page; 1.0 provenance is inferred from its exact match with the 299-pal 1.0 paldex and 1.0-only species.
